reader.notes: BindMerge checks USING and GIVING files together by file identity; file-name-1 written again is refused earlier by SortMapIoFiles' SD refusal, so every repetition is refused. One side effect: after the refused MERGE, a RETURN in its output procedure also draws COBOL7081 (no output-procedure range is registered for a rejected MERGE). That is a cascade diagnostic, not a breach of this rule.
